title: DOE and Battelle Institute as UFO secret keepers

tellings.quote: I kept poting the doe I kept asking about why people weren't Looking At Doe I kept asking why people weren't looking at the battel Institute

plain: The real keepers of UFO secrets, by this account, may be the Department of Energy and the Battelle Institute, a private research institute, rather than the agencies people usually look at. A guest named Bob Maguire tells Michels that he kept pointing to the Department of Energy and kept asking why nobody was looking at it or at Battelle. He gives this as his own view and names no source.
